description.content:
The controller is responsible for handling operations on filter objects. Filter can be used throughout the system to filter data.
    It can be passed wherever filterId query parameter or property is available.
    Some apis are exposed through FiltersV1 and some through FiltersV2 both can be used interchangeably.
Retrieves all saved filters for the current user.

query.description: Set to true to include filters for the dashboard only. Otherwise, all filters will be returned.
